fato_historico: 2022: At least 93 people die and 25 are missing after a magnitude 6.8 earthquake strikes Sichuan, China.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound sense of resilience as you navigate shifting emotional grounds. Just as nature reminds us of the fragility and enduring spirit of life after sudden trembles in the earth, you are encouraged to ground your fiery energy. It is a good time to nurture your inner stability and cherish every connection you hold dear today.
frase_do_dia: Strength blooms brightest when we embrace the gentle power of our own heart.
significado_numero: Represents the compassionate courage to rebuild and move forward with hope.
conselho: Consider taking a moment to appreciate the steady foundation beneath your feet today.
